name: spline
title: Spline
blurb: Spline 3D scene viewer with lazy loading and render-on-demand option.
description: Renders interactive 3D scenes from Spline.design via dynamic @splinetool/runtime import. Supports lazy loading, render-on-demand optimization, and children render as loading placeholder.
use_when: Interactive 3D product showcases, immersive landing pages, or design portfolios featuring Spline scenes.
avoid_when: Low-end devices; requires significant bundle size and GPU. Requires valid Spline.design scene URL.
a11y: Canvas-based 3D rendering; no native accessibility for 3D objects; children render as loading fallback.
